source_index_lines: - [[eac-klipsch-rp-600m-ii]] — Erin's Audio Corner Klippel review, 2022-05-22 (Tier A)
- [[mfr-klipsch-rp-600m-ii]] — Klipsch product page and spec sheet (Tier C)
brand_notes: RP-600M II: Reference Premiere line, horn-loaded titanium tweeter, claimed 94.5 dB half-space but measured ~85.4 dB (eac-klipsch-rp-600m-ii); labelled '8 Ω compatible' yet 3.5 Ω min (effectively 4 Ω). Critics call Klipsch lively/bright, needs amp matching (hifitrends, stereonet).
takeaways: Klippel: LW ±1.9 dB, f3 68 Hz, hor 94 deg, treble lift from ~8 kHz; EAC suggests 20 deg toe-out or grille.
Measured sensitivity 85.4 dB vs claimed 94.5 dB (half-space).
Min impedance 3.5 Ω, EPDR 1.8 Ω: effectively-4ohm flag despite 8 Ω compatible label.
THD ~0.7% at 86 dB, ~2.0% at 96 dB (graph-read); compression <=1 dB at 102 dB.
Critics: lively, dynamic, easy to drive; bright, not neutral. User data anecdotal.
conflicts: Sensitivity claimed 94.5 dB vs measured 85.4 dB
Impedance 8 Ω compatible vs 3.5 Ω min
Claimed 44 Hz -3 dB vs measured f3 68 Hz
